{{Top|leg}}
An '''observation cell''' was a [[Detention area|detention cell]] with a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] window set high above the room to allow individuals to observe the interior. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] used an observation cell to watch his [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Kl'aal]], kill and eat a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified female prisoner|prisoner]]. Unfortunately for the Moff, Kl'aal refused to entertain his employer.
